title: iOSWorld: A Benchmark for Personally Intelligent Phone Agents
authors_zh: Lawrence Keunho Jang, Mareks Woodside, Geronimo Carom, Andrew Keunwoo Jang, Jing Yu Koh, Ruslan Salakhutdinov
paper_type_zh: 原生iOS智能体交互基准与可执行环境
best_for_zh: 研究移动GUI智能体、环境交互轨迹、rubric-based judge、MCP工具与回放审计的读者
one_line: iOSWorld releases 26 connected SwiftUI apps and 133 rubric-scored tasks with reproducible reset/trajectory tooling, but its GPT-5.4 Mini feedback is judgment-based and only 16 curated runs, not the full success/failure corpus, are public.
iOSWorld发布26个互联SwiftUI应用、133项任务与1,123条rubric，并开放seed state、runner、MCP和episode judge；但完整成败rollout语料未公开，现阶段仅适合评测复用。
why: It turns a persistent fictional phone identity into an executable environment/data contract linking task, seeded state, screenshot or XML observation, GUI/MCP action, final answer, rubric labels, and pass/fail, while making simulator versioning, judge calibration, confirmation safety, split policy, and raw failure retention first-class audit concerns.
inclusion_reason: iOSWorld makes persistent cross-app personal state, GUI observations/actions, task-level reset, trajectory capture, and a rubric-based episode judge jointly inspectable in a native iOS environment. It is a core Track 6 entry because it also exposes how privileged accessibility input, judge error, simulator/version drift, selective trajectory release, and risky-action confirmation determine whether mobile-agent episodes are trustworthy reasoning-data objects.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The primary sources are arXiv:2606.09764v1, submitted 8 June 2026, the official project, and the official repository inspected at commit e91f4cb2ef4c9dd48fef83a894477b41fd5e209d. The verified publication status is an arXiv preprint; an exact ICML 2026 AIWILD workshop forum was not resolved.

iOSWorld addresses a specific evaluation gap: a phone agent may complete an isolated screen-level action yet fail when a task depends on personal state distributed across finance, messaging, travel, food, productivity, and other applications. The benchmark therefore places one fictional persona, Jordan Avery, in 26 connected SwiftUI apps and supplies 133 first-person tasks: 27 single-app, 60 multi-app, and 46 memory/personalization tasks. The released tasks.json contains 1,123 rubric criteria, with 4-13 criteria per task and a mean of 8.4.

The canonical released object is a task/rubric and deterministic seeded simulator environment. A runner-generated episode adds screenshot or screenshot-plus-XCUITest observations, actions, optional reasoning/messages, final state and answer, criterion judgments, a rubric fraction, and strict pass/fail. This makes iOSWorld relevant to environment_agent_trajectory_data: task state, observation/action interaction, reset, episode capture, and terminal feedback are specified together.

The decision boundary is equally important. The repository releases the 26 apps, seed fixtures, task manifest, runners, evaluator, MCP servers, and AWS EC2 Mac helpers, but not the complete experimental success/failure rollout corpus; the official site shows only 16 curated Opus 4.6 vision+XML trajectories. The paper evaluates agents and reports no SFT, RL, preference, reward-model, or agent training on iOSWorld episodes. These sources support L4-depth bilingual screening content, while accepted workflow metadata correctly remains L3_summary_ready and training reuse remains outside the evidenced scope.

本卡的主要来源是2026年6月8日提交的arXiv:2606.09764v1、官方项目页，以及在提交e91f4cb2ef4c9dd48fef83a894477b41fd5e209d上检查的官方仓库。已核实的发表状态为arXiv预印本；尚未定位到确切的ICML 2026 AIWILD workshop forum条目。

iOSWorld针对一个具体评测缺口：手机智能体可能完成孤立的界面动作，却会在任务依赖分散于金融、消息、旅行、餐饮、生产力等多个应用中的个人状态时失败。为此，基准把虚构人物Jordan Avery置于26个互联SwiftUI应用中，并提供133项第一人称任务：27项single-app、60项multi-app、46项memory/personalization任务。已发布的tasks.json共有1,123条rubric criterion，每项任务含4-13条，均值为8.4条。

正式发布的canonical object是task/rubric与确定性seeded simulator environment。runner生成的episode在此基础上加入截图或截图加XCUITest观察、动作、可选reasoning/messages、最终状态与答案、逐criterion判断、rubric fraction和严格pass/fail。它因此属于environment_agent_trajectory_data：任务状态、观察/动作交互、重置、episode记录和终态反馈被一并定义。

边界同样关键。仓库已发布26个应用、seed fixture、任务清单、runner、evaluator、MCP server和AWS EC2 Mac辅助工具，但没有公开完整实验的成功/失败rollout语料；官网只展示16条精选的Opus 4.6 vision+XML轨迹。论文仅评测智能体，没有报告使用iOSWorld episode进行SFT、RL、偏好学习、reward-model训练或agent training。这些来源足以支撑L4深度的双语筛选正文，但accepted workflow metadata仍应保持L3_summary_ready，训练复用也不在证据范围内。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
iOSWorld's contribution is an executable native-iOS evaluation contract that binds a persistent fictional identity, deterministic app state, multimodal agent interaction, task-specific rubrics, and a post-hoc episode judge. The 26 apps share connected synthetic records rather than presenting independent mock screens. Before each normal task, the runner reboots the simulator, wipes manifest-listed app data plus the shared workspace app-group container, launches every app to reseed, terminates them, and returns to the home screen; this is an app-data reset, not restoration of an immutable simulator image.

The feedback contract is judgment_required. GPT-5.4 Mini receives the goal, full sequence of screenshots and actions, final answer, and 4-13 task-specific criteria. It returns an overall success decision and per-criterion satisfied flags with reasons. The scalar reward is the satisfied-criterion fraction; strict pass requires every criterion. Supervision therefore attaches to the full_episode and produces scalar_reward plus binary success, not verified state-action labels or a demonstrated training reward.

This judge can assess visible progress and semantic reports across a trajectory, but it does not directly execute a programmatic database predicate. Off-screen state, omitted rubric conditions, alternate valid paths, harmful intermediate side effects, and API-model drift remain outside or imperfectly observed. Human validation on 128 Opus 4.6 vision+XML trajectories found 89% task agreement and 86% rubric accuracy, so the judge is calibrated evidence rather than ground truth.

Relative to Android mobile benchmarks, the concrete change is a native iOS substrate with one connected persistent persona. Relative to AndroidWorld-style programmatic checking, the primary success interface is a rubric-conditioned trajectory judge. Optional per-app MCP servers add typed operations and raise a separate question: they can bypass visible UI transitions, and risky prepare/confirm pairs exist while expanded confirmation is off by default and legacy direct verbs remain available. The work combines established simulator, accessibility, LLM-judge, and tool-server components; its direction signal is their inspectable episode-level binding, not any one component in isolation.

iOSWorld的贡献是一套可执行的原生iOS评测契约：把持续存在的虚构身份、确定性应用状态、多模态智能体交互、任务特定rubric和事后episode judge绑定在一起。26个应用共享互联的合成记录，而不是彼此独立的模拟界面。每项常规任务开始前，runner会重启模拟器，清除manifest所列应用的数据容器及共享workspace app-group容器，逐个启动应用完成reseed，再终止应用并返回主屏幕；这属于应用数据重置，并非恢复不可变的模拟器镜像。

反馈契约是judgment_required。GPT-5.4 Mini接收任务goal、完整截图与动作序列、最终答案，以及每项任务4-13条criterion，输出整体success判断和带理由的逐criterion satisfied标记。scalar reward是满足criterion的比例；严格pass要求全部criterion均满足。因此监督附着于full_episode，并产生scalar_reward与二值成功标签，而不是经过验证的state-action label，也不是论文证明可用于训练的reward。

该judge可以跨整条轨迹评估可见进展和语义报告，但不会直接执行程序化数据库predicate。屏外状态、rubric遗漏的条件、其他有效路径、有害的中间副作用及API模型漂移，都无法被充分或稳定观察。对128条Opus 4.6 vision+XML轨迹的人类验证显示，任务级一致率为89%，rubric级准确率为86%；因此judge是经过校准的证据，而不是真值。

相对Android移动端基准，具体变化是原生iOS substrate与一个互联、持续的persona。相对AndroidWorld式程序化检查，其主要成功接口是rubric-conditioned trajectory judge。可选的逐应用MCP server提供typed operation，也带来另一层问题：它们可能绕过可见UI转移；高风险动作虽有prepare/confirm pair，但扩展确认界面默认关闭，legacy direct verb仍可用。论文组合了已有的模拟器、accessibility、LLM judge和tool server组件；方向价值来自这些组件在episode层面的可审计绑定，而非某一组件本身。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs and construction. Authors built one synthetic persona and connected seed records across 26 SwiftUI apps. Claude Code, with full app-source and seed-data access, generated 175 task candidates. A Python pipeline normalized app names, rewrote instructions into first person, and generated rubrics. Humans executed every candidate end-to-end, corrected 44, trimmed single-app tasks for coverage and minimal duplication, retained all multi-app and memory tasks, and produced 133 tasks with 1,123 criteria. The generator prompt, Claude Code snapshot, decoding settings, 44 correction diffs, 42-removal ledger, reviewer identities, and record-level provenance are unknown.

Reset and rollout. The released runner shuts down and boots the simulator, wipes app and shared-container data, launches all apps to recreate seed state, terminates them, and returns to home. An evaluated provider adapter then receives either a 706x1536 screenshot or that screenshot plus a cleaned XCUITest tree capped at 200 elements and 15 levels. Common actions are coordinate tap, type, swipe, home, wait, and stop; vision+XML adapters can also expose identifier tap, launch, terminate, and URL opening. The loop uses Appium/XCUITest and ends on stop or a 50-step cap. Optional MCP mode substitutes typed app-specific tools while retaining screenshots.

Outputs and feedback. A generated run can write per-step screenshots/XML, planned and executed actions, execution errors, optional reasoning summaries and LLM messages, pre/post-action views, trajectory.json, events.jsonl, task.json, final state and answer, token usage, evaluator output, and run metadata. GPT-5.4 Mini then judges the full trajectory and rubric. Criterion satisfaction is averaged into a scalar fraction; all criteria must pass for strict success. Runner statuses such as execution failed or safety_blocked are distinct from ordinary rubric failure.

Use and reproducibility. The paper uses these episodes only for evaluation across twelve model-by-modality configurations. Main results report one aggregate outcome per task/configuration, not repeated stochastic rollouts. The code logs simulator UDID, platform/device, Xcode, Python, Node, Appium, macOS, provider/model, temperature, budget, observation/action modes, manifest, and task file, but the published results are not bound to an immutable run manifest. Reproduction requires pinning the repository commit, task file, app builds, Xcode/iOS/Appium/WebDriverAgent stack, device geometry, reset manifest, provider APIs, temperature, seeds, retries, timeouts, judge snapshot, and result checksums. No train/dev/test field, decontamination procedure, complete raw run bundle, or deterministic replay test is released.

输入与构造。 作者围绕一个合成persona，在26个SwiftUI应用中构建互联seed记录。Claude Code在可访问完整应用源码与seed data的条件下生成175个候选任务；Python pipeline负责规范应用名称、把指令改写为第一人称并生成rubric。人类逐项端到端执行候选任务，修正其中44项，为扩大覆盖且减少重复而裁剪single-app任务，并保留全部multi-app与memory任务，最终得到133项任务、1,123条criterion。generator prompt、Claude Code snapshot、decoding setting、44项修订diff、42项移除清单、reviewer身份及record-level provenance均为unknown。

重置与rollout。 已发布runner会关闭并启动模拟器，清除应用与共享容器数据，逐个启动全部应用恢复seed state，再终止应用并返回主屏幕。随后，被评测的provider adapter接收706x1536截图，或在截图之外接收清洗后的XCUITest tree；后者最多200个元素、15层。通用动作包括坐标tap、type、swipe、home、wait和stop；vision+XML adapter还可暴露identifier tap、launch、terminate和open URL。交互通过Appium/XCUITest执行，在智能体发出stop或达到50步时结束。可选MCP模式以逐应用typed tool替代部分GUI动作，同时保留截图。

输出与反馈。 一次生成运行可以写出逐步截图/XML、计划与执行动作、执行错误、可选reasoning summary和LLM message、动作前后视图、trajectory.json、events.jsonl、task.json、最终状态与答案、token usage、evaluator output及run metadata。GPT-5.4 Mini随后依据完整轨迹和rubric评分。满足criterion的比例形成scalar fraction，全部criterion通过才算严格成功。runner的执行failed或safety_blocked状态不同于正常的rubric失败。

用途与复现。 论文只把episode用于十二种model-by-modality配置的评测。主结果对每个任务/配置报告一个汇总结果，不是重复随机rollout。代码可记录simulator UDID、platform/device、Xcode、Python、Node、Appium、macOS、provider/model、temperature、budget、observation/action mode、manifest和task file，但公开结果没有绑定不可变run manifest。复现需要固定仓库提交、任务文件、应用构建、Xcode/iOS/Appium/WebDriverAgent栈、设备几何、reset manifest、provider API、temperature、seed、retry、timeout、judge snapshot和结果checksum。项目没有发布train/dev/test字段、decontamination流程、完整raw run bundle或确定性replay test。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
All numbers below are author-reported and were not independently replayed. On the 133-task suite with a 50-step cap, the strongest reported configuration is Opus 4.6 vision+XML: 51.9% overall strict pass, comprising 81.5% single-app, 36.7% multi-app, and 54.3% memory/personalization. These scores characterize model behavior under the published environment and judge; they do not prove task correctness, data quality, or real-device readiness (Paper Table 3).

The judge was compared with humans on 128 Opus 4.6 vision+XML trajectories. The paper reports 89% task-level agreement, Cohen's kappa 0.77, and F1 0.86; at rubric level it reports 86% accuracy, kappa 0.69, and F1 0.90. Across 1,094 judged criteria, 148 disagreements comprise 79 false positives and 69 false negatives. Semantic/report criteria show the largest error, roughly 13-16%, and task-level direction differs by category: the judge tends to over-accept single-app and over-reject multi-app cases (Appendix J, Tables 10 and 13-14).

The MCP ablation holds Qwen3.5 35B, all 133 tasks, the judge, and the 50-step budget fixed. Replacing GUI-only interaction with structured per-app MCP tools raises strict pass from 12.8% to 24.8% and mean rubric score from 0.33 to 0.683. This supports the narrower claim that tool interface changes outcomes under the same evaluation contract; it does not isolate training-data quality or establish that direct persistence-layer tools match deployable phone interaction (Section 4.3 and Appendix E).

Failure analysis includes all 422 failures from five frontier vision+XML configurations: 51% exhausted the budget, 26% gave up, and 23% stopped prematurely. Qwen vision+XML had 119 failures, 60 flagged as extreme action loops. This shows failures existed and were analyzed internally, but not that raw failures were publicly retained. The public project displays only 16 selected Opus 4.6 vision+XML trajectories, while repository results/ and artifacts/ are ignored; independent episode-level auditing therefore remains incomplete.

以下数字均为作者报告，尚未被独立replay。在50步上限下对全部133项任务评测时，最佳报告配置为Opus 4.6 vision+XML：严格pass总计51.9%，其中single-app为81.5%、multi-app为36.7%、memory/personalization为54.3%。这些分数描述特定环境与judge条件下的模型行为，不能证明任务正确、数据质量高或模型可安全部署到真实设备（论文表3）。

作者在128条Opus 4.6 vision+XML轨迹上把judge与人类比较：任务级一致率89%、Cohen's kappa 0.77、F1 0.86；rubric级准确率86%、kappa 0.69、F1 0.90。对1,094条被判断criterion，共有148处分歧，其中79个false positive、69个false negative。semantic/report类criterion误差最高，约13%-16%；任务级偏差方向还随类别变化，judge倾向于过度接受single-app、过度拒绝multi-app样本（附录J，表10、13-14）。

MCP消融固定Qwen3.5 35B、全部133项任务、judge和50步预算。把GUI-only交互替换为结构化逐应用MCP tool后，严格pass从12.8%升至24.8%，mean rubric score从0.33升至0.683。该结果只支持“工具接口在同一评测契约下会改变结果”，不能用于判断训练数据质量，也不能证明direct persistence-layer tool等同于可部署的手机交互（第4.3节与附录E）。

失败分析覆盖五种前沿vision+XML配置的全部422次失败：51%耗尽预算、26%放弃、23%过早停止。Qwen vision+XML有119次失败，其中60次被标记为极端action loop。这证明作者内部保留并分析过失败，却不能证明raw failure已公开。官方项目只展示16条精选Opus 4.6 vision+XML轨迹，仓库还忽略results/和artifacts/；因此外部仍无法完成episode级独立审计。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
AndroidWorld, AndroidLab, SPA-Bench, B-MoCA, GUI Odyssey, and related mobile-agent benchmarks already provide screenshot/action evaluation, accessibility information, multi-step tasks, or programmatic checking. iOSWorld's concrete change is to make native iOS the substrate and connect 26 apps through one persistent synthetic persona, so multi-app and memory tasks depend on shared personal state rather than only local screen transitions.

The second change is the released evaluation object: a 133-record task manifest with 1,123 criteria is coupled to deterministic app-data reseeding, rich trajectory capture, and a full-episode GPT-5.4 Mini rubric judge. The feedback interface exposes both criterion satisfaction fractions and all-criteria strict pass. It is judgment-based rather than an AndroidWorld-style programmatic end-state contract, which expands semantic coverage but makes judge calibration, API pinning, rubric completeness, and false-positive/false-negative analysis part of the data specification.

The optional MCP layer is another inspectable interface variation. It preserves the benchmark tasks and judge while replacing portions of screen-level action with typed per-app operations. The reported Qwen ablation demonstrates that this interface materially changes outcomes, but MCP, Appium, XCUITest, LLM judging, and simulator reset are established components. Likewise, 26 apps and 133 tasks are scale and integration, not independent evidence of record-level quality.

For reasoning-data research, the direction signal is an executable chain from synthetic state and task provenance through reset, observation/action episode, rubric judgment, and failure analysis. Before reuse, researchers still need an immutable environment/result bundle, complete success and failure trajectories, judge prompt/API snapshot, record-level construction lineage, explicit evaluation split and contamination policy, and complete third-party attribution. Without those checks, the release is a benchmark recipe rather than an open training-trajectory corpus.

AndroidWorld、AndroidLab、SPA-Bench、B-MoCA、GUI Odyssey等移动智能体基准已经提供截图/动作评测、accessibility信息、多步任务或程序化检查。iOSWorld的具体变化，是把原生iOS作为substrate，并通过一个持续存在的合成persona连接26个应用，使multi-app与memory任务依赖共享个人状态，而不只依赖局部界面转移。

第二项变化是已发布的评测对象：含133条记录、1,123条criterion的任务manifest，与确定性应用数据reseed、丰富的trajectory capture和GPT-5.4 Mini full-episode rubric judge相耦合。反馈接口同时给出criterion满足比例与“全部criterion通过”的严格pass。它属于judgment-based contract，而不是AndroidWorld式程序化end-state contract；这扩大了语义覆盖，也使judge calibration、API固定、rubric完整性及false positive/false negative分析成为数据规范的一部分。

可选MCP层提供另一种可检查的接口变化：保持任务与judge不变，以逐应用typed operation替代部分screen-level action。Qwen消融说明接口会实质影响结果，但MCP、Appium、XCUITest、LLM judging和模拟器重置都不是新组件。同样，26个应用与133项任务体现规模和工程整合，不能独立证明record-level quality。

对推理数据研究而言，方向信号来自一条可执行链：合成状态与任务provenance、reset、observation/action episode、rubric judgment及failure analysis。复用前仍需核实不可变的环境/结果bundle、完整成功与失败轨迹、judge prompt/API snapshot、逐记录构造lineage、明确的评测split与contamination政策，以及完整第三方归因。在这些检查完成前，该发布应被视为benchmark recipe，而非开放训练轨迹语料。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Release boundary: The 26 apps, seed data, 133 tasks, 1,123 criteria, runner, evaluator, MCP servers, and local trajectory writer are released. The complete experimental corpus of successful, failed, timed-out, safety-blocked, judge-error, and retried episodes is not; only 16 curated trajectory views are public. Public success/failure selection and retry retention are unknown.
  • Judge fidelity: GPT-5.4 Mini is a closed, unpinned API judge. Human comparison still finds 79 criterion false positives and 69 false negatives, with category-dependent bias and higher semantic/report error. Rubric omissions, visually plausible but state-incorrect outcomes, off-screen state, and harmful intermediate actions can escape the primary contract.
  • Replay and environment drift: Reset wipes and reseeds app data rather than restoring a complete immutable simulator. No tagged release binds built-app digests, simulator image, Xcode/iOS/Appium/WebDriverAgent versions, model APIs, seeds, retries, task/result checksums, and judge calls. Screenshots, XML trees, actions, and labels can drift.
  • Split and exposure: The 133 task records have category and difficulty fields but no train/dev/test split. No decontamination, evaluated-model training-overlap, prompt-leakage, or future leaderboard exposure policy is disclosed. Public tasks, rubrics, evaluator prompts, and seed state permit memorization and judge gaming.
  • Construction and attribution: The Claude Code prompt/snapshot/settings, 175-candidate ledger, correction/removal diffs, reviewers, and record-level provenance are absent. The root is Apache-2.0 and nested MIT notices exist, but the Notes README references a missing root ATTRIBUTIONS.md; complete source, seed, visual-asset, gallery, and generated-trajectory rights are not itemized.
  • Safety and generalization: All data and the Jordan Avery persona are synthetic, which avoids real-user consent claims but does not establish real-device safety. Tasks include purchases, payments, reservations, and messages. MCP prepare/confirm pairs are not the default expanded interface and legacy risky verbs remain exposed; direct persistence tools may bypass human-visible UI. Results from one fictional persona and one iOS/Xcode generation should not be generalized to real services or users.

• 发布边界： 26个应用、seed data、133项任务、1,123条criterion、runner、evaluator、MCP server和本地trajectory writer均已发布，但完整实验的成功、失败、超时、safety-blocked、judge-error及retry episode语料没有公开；公众只能看到16条精选轨迹。公开样本的成败选择规则和retry保留规则为unknown。
  • Judge保真度： GPT-5.4 Mini是闭源且未固定snapshot的API judge。人类对照仍发现79个criterion false positive和69个false negative，并存在类别相关偏差及更高的semantic/report误差。rubric遗漏、视觉上合理但状态错误的结果、屏外状态与有害中间动作，都可能逃过主要反馈契约。
  • 回放与环境漂移： reset只清除并重建应用数据，不会恢复完整不可变模拟器。项目没有用tagged release绑定应用构建digest、模拟器镜像、Xcode/iOS/Appium/WebDriverAgent版本、模型API、seed、retry、任务/结果checksum和judge call；截图、XML tree、动作和标签都可能漂移。
  • 划分与公开暴露： 133条任务记录有category与difficulty字段，但没有train/dev/test split。论文未披露decontamination、被测模型训练重叠、prompt leakage或未来leaderboard exposure政策。公开任务、rubric、evaluator prompt和seed state允许记忆与judge gaming。
  • 构造与归因： Claude Code prompt/snapshot/setting、175项候选清单、修订与移除diff、reviewer及逐记录provenance均缺失。根仓库采用Apache-2.0并保留若干嵌套MIT notice，但Notes README引用的根ATTRIBUTIONS.md不存在；源码、seed、视觉资产、gallery和生成轨迹的完整权利清单未被逐项说明。
  • 安全与泛化： 全部数据及Jordan Avery persona均为合成内容，因此不涉及真实用户同意主张，但不能证明真实设备安全。任务包含购买、支付、预订和消息操作。MCP prepare/confirm pair并非默认扩展接口，legacy risky verb仍暴露；direct persistence tool还可能绕过人类可见UI。单一虚构persona和单一代际iOS/Xcode上的结果不能直接泛化到真实服务或用户。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the environment_agent_trajectory_data track, iOSWorld is an evaluation-environment recipe. A robust derived record should preserve task ID and rubric, seed-state version, app/build manifest, simulator and toolchain versions, observation modality, screenshots/XML, normalized actions or MCP calls, execution errors, final state/answer, stop reason, model/API settings, criterion labels, scalar fraction, strict pass, and raw judge response. Joining successes and all failure classes to the same pinned task object would support planning, grounding, loop, premature-stop, judge-error, and environment-drift audits.

The released rubric evaluator is useful for feedback-contract studies. Researchers can compare the full-trajectory LLM judgment with programmatic end-state checks or human labels, stratify false positives and false negatives by criterion/category, test alternate valid paths and harmful intermediate actions, and measure label drift across fixed judge snapshots. The public 1,123 criteria are also an evaluator-gaming surface and should not be treated as hidden reward.

The GUI-versus-MCP setup enables controlled interface studies if model, tasks, 50-step budget, judge, and seed state remain fixed. Such studies should separately report privileged XCUITest or persistence-layer access, confirmation settings, and screen-visible GUI actions; otherwise improved scores can be misattributed to reasoning instead of a stronger action interface.

The current reuse class is evaluation and audit only, matching training_use: evaluation. Direct SFT, RL, preference, or reward-model reuse is blocked because no full trajectory corpus, training/evaluation partition, decontamination policy, immutable replay bundle, judge snapshot, or complete asset/license lineage is available. Benchmark performance motivates these audits but does not certify episode quality.

对environment_agent_trajectory_data轨道而言，iOSWorld是一套评测环境recipe。可靠的派生记录应保存task ID与rubric、seed-state版本、应用/构建manifest、模拟器与工具链版本、observation modality、截图/XML、规范化action或MCP call、执行错误、最终状态/答案、停止原因、模型/API设置、criterion label、scalar fraction、strict pass和raw judge response。把成功episode与所有失败类型连接到同一个固定任务对象，可支持planning、grounding、loop、premature stop、judge error及环境漂移审计。

已发布的rubric evaluator可用于反馈契约研究。研究者可以把full-trajectory LLM judgment与程序化end-state check或人类标签比较，按criterion/category分层分析false positive和false negative，测试其他有效路径与有害中间动作，并测量固定judge snapshot之间的标签漂移。公开的1,123条criterion同时构成evaluator-gaming表面，不能视为隐藏reward。

GUI与MCP两种设置可用于受控接口研究，前提是固定模型、任务、50步预算、judge和seed state。研究还应分别报告特权XCUITest或persistence-layer访问、确认设置及屏幕可见GUI动作；否则，分数提升可能被错误归因于reasoning，而实际来自更强action interface。

当前复用等级是仅限评测与审计，与training_use: evaluation一致。直接用于SFT、RL、偏好学习或reward-model训练仍受阻，因为完整轨迹语料、训练/评测划分、decontamination政策、不可变replay bundle、judge snapshot及完整资产/许可lineage均未提供。benchmark performance可以推动这些审计，但不能认证episode质量。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Sections 3.1-3.3 and Appendix H first to reconstruct seeded state, the Appium/XCUITest loop, observation/action modes, task/rubric schema, and trajectory judge.
  • Keep the released counts together: 26 connected apps, 133 tasks split 27/60/46, and 1,123 criteria at 4-13 per task; these are benchmark objects, not a released training corpus.
  • Interpret feedback as judgment_required, full_episode, and scalar_reward; strict pass means every criterion was accepted by GPT-5.4 Mini, not that a programmatic state predicate succeeded.
  • Read Appendix J before comparing categories: judge agreement is imperfect, with 79 criterion false positives, 69 false negatives, and direction-dependent task bias.
  • Separate executable release from trajectory release: seed state, runner, evaluator, MCP servers, and task JSON are public, while only 16 curated runs, not the full success/failure corpus, are visible.
  • Before reuse, verify the repository/toolchain/API snapshot, replay manifest, split and decontamination policy, raw failures and retries, risky-action confirmation defaults, and missing third-party attribution details.

• 先读第3.1-3.3节与附录H，以重建seeded state、Appium/XCUITest loop、observation/action mode、task/rubric schema和trajectory judge。
  • 把发布规模放在一起理解：26个互联应用、按27/60/46划分的133项任务、共1,123条criterion且每项4-13条；这些是benchmark object，不是已发布训练语料。
  • 把反馈解释为judgment_required、full_episode和scalar_reward；严格pass表示GPT-5.4 Mini接受全部criterion，而非程序化state predicate执行成功。
  • 比较任务类别前先读附录J：judge一致性并不完美，存在79个criterion false positive、69个false negative及方向随类别变化的任务级偏差。
  • 区分可执行发布与轨迹发布：seed state、runner、evaluator、MCP server和task JSON已公开，但公众只能看到16条精选run，而非完整成功/失败语料。
  • 复用前需核实仓库/工具链/API snapshot、replay manifest、split与decontamination政策、raw failure与retry、高风险动作确认默认值，以及缺失的第三方归因细节。
